'''Encot''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He was the [[Sheriff/Legends|sheriff]] of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]].

During the Cold War, he asked a Republic-allied individual to help take down the [[Twin Suns (pirates)|Twin Suns]] pirates. The pirates were expanding their operations into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]], and had taken a group of settlers captive. While Encot did not know the location of the slaves, the police had discovered a Twin Suns operation smuggling [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] off-planet in a [[Anchorhead Eastern Warehouse|warehouse]] nearby. The individual stormed the warehouse and recovered data on the slaves' location. The individual fought their way through the pirates in another warehouse, freeing the slaves.

==Behind the scenes==
Encot is a non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He is voiced by [[Fred Tatasciore]].
